In our community, it is essential to care for our fishing nets, as they are vital to our livelihood. Each week, we gather to mend and repair the nets, ensuring they remain strong and ready for the next fishing season. The process is not only a way to preserve our resources but also a way to strengthen our community bonds. As we work together, we carry with us the spirit of unity and resilience.  

P.P.S. Do not forget the weather.
